title: ewm project profile
description: Project profile for the Engineering Workflow Mod (ewm), read from .ewm/project.yaml or .ewm/project.json. Mirrors the Profile type in src/types.ts; the defaults are DEFAULT_PROFILE in src/profile.ts. Holds configuration only, never task state.

profile_id.description: Short id stored on every task. Must not be blank.

name.description: Human-readable project name. Must not be blank.

repositories.description: Repository roots, relative to the workspace.

domains.description: Business or technical areas the project covers.

entrypoints.description: Where exploration starts: repo-relative files or directories.

external_network.description: deny_by_default blocks web access, outbound tools, third-party MCP tools and network commands while a task is active.

require_plan_approval.description: When true, moving from PLAN to IMPLEMENT needs a recorded human approval.

allow_write_in_explore.description: When true, repository writes are allowed during EXPLORE.

allowed_mcp_tools.description: Third-party MCP tool names allowed while a task is active: exact names, or a prefix ending in '*'.

lead.description: Model for the lead role. Recorded in the profile; not routed in v0.0.0.

search.description: Model for the search agents (ewm:repo-scout, ewm:docs-scout).

max_parallel_researchers.description: Maximum research agents running at once.

max_research_rounds_without_user_update.description: Research rounds allowed before the model must report back to the person.

max_findings_per_scout.description: Maximum findings a scout returns per delegation.

commands.description: Allowlisted validation commands, such as "npm test". Run without a shell.

timeout_ms.description: Time limit for each validation command, in milliseconds.
